issues.description: The solution introduces an additional 'age' attribute on Animal and uses two-argument constructors (String name, int age) for Animal and all concrete animals (Seal, Pig, Goat). The problem statement and the template's Main class imply single-argument constructors that only take the animal's name (e.g., Seal("Clarabelle")). This discrepancy between the expected single-argument constructors and the solution's two-argument constructors will confuse students and may cause mismatch with provided example usage and tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor signatures consistent across artifacts. Either: (A) Remove the 'age' attribute and change Animal and all concrete animal constructors to accept only String name (Animal(String name)), updating solution classes accordingly to match the template/Main and problem description; or (B) Update the problem statement documentation and the template Main examples to require an int age parameter and show instantiations like new Seal("Clarabelle", 3), and update any tests to expect two-argument constructors. Option A is the simpler fix to match the current problem description and template examples.

issues.description: Constructor / attribute mismatch for Animal and its subclasses: the problem statement (and the provided template Main usage) presents animals as having only a name and shows single-argument constructions (e.g., Seal("Clarabelle")). The solution introduces an additional attribute 'age' and uses two-argument constructors (Animal(String name, int age), Seal(String name, int age), etc.). This divergence in constructor signatures and attributes creates a mapping/confusion for students who will expect single-argument constructors based on the problem and template but find two-argument constructors in the solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor/attribute definitions consistent across artifacts. Either remove the extra 'age' attribute from the solution and use single-argument constructors (e.g., Animal(String name), Seal(String name)), or update the problem statement and template examples to declare and demonstrate the 'age' attribute and two-argument constructors so all artifacts use the same constructor signature.
